mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The positive return rate in FEDFUNDS<=3.5% periods is not significantly higher than the overall positive return rate (65.5%) at p<0.05 (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals an inflationary environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expected monetary tightening.
failure_condition: The negative return rate in CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% periods is not significantly higher than the baseline negative return rate (34.1%) at p<0.05 (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3.5% and the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) increase exceeds 3.0%, the market experiences stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return rate in FEDFUNDS<=3.5% AND CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% periods is not significantly higher than the baseline negative return rate (34.1%) at p<0.05 (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to strong economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The positive return rate in UNRATE<4.0% periods is not significantly higher than the overall positive return rate (65.5%) at p<0.05 (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 2000.0) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong consumer confidence and economic growth.
failure_condition: The positive return rate in HOUST>2000.0 periods is not significantly higher than the overall positive return rate (65.5%) at p<0.05 (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO > 120.0) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return rate in INDPRO>120.0 periods is not significantly higher than the overall positive return rate (65.5%) at p<0.05 (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2000.0 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 350000.0, the strong housing market signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return rate in HOUST>2000.0 AND RSAFS>350000.0 periods is not significantly higher than the overall positive return rate (65.5%) at p<0.05 (t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return rate in UNRATE>5.0% periods is not significantly higher than the baseline negative return rate (34.1%) at p<0.05 (t-test).
